fields.description: Riwa is a three-building residential collection at Madinat Jumeirah Living. One- to three-bedroom apartments sit alongside a four-bedroom penthouse. Its contemporary buildings introduce sky gardens, while individual plans distinguish enclosed suites from balconies and larger outdoor terraces.
